results.note: Chronicon Hildesheimense (Migne PL 141): No English translation found. A modern German translation was published by K. Nass (2006), but no English version is readily available.
Chronicon S. Huberti Andaginensis (Migne PL 154): No English translation found. The chronicle exists in Latin and French editions, but no complete English translation is available.
De duodecim portis Jerusalem (Migne PL 184): No English translation found. This short work (cols 1117C-1122C) does not appear in standard medieval translation databases.
Fragmentum vetusti kalendarii Hispani (Migne PL 85): No English translation found. This small Hispanic calendar fragment (632 words) appears not to have been translated into English.

Itinerarium (Migne PL 8): English translation 'The Itinerary of Bernard the Wise' translated by J.H. Bernard, published by Palestine Pilgrims' Text Society, London 1893. This is a public-domain translation from the PPTS series.
Kalendarium Stabulense (Migne PL 138): No English translation found. This liturgical calendar from Stabulo/Malmedy monastery does not appear in standard medieval translation databases.

Missale mixtum (Migne PL 85): English translation by Fr. Hieromonk Aidan (Keller) of the Russian Orthodox Church, published by St. John Cassian Press, copyright dated 2001/2006. Based on the Missale Mixtum of Cardinal Ximenes and Migne's Patrologia Latina. Modern copyrighted translation.

Tractatus adversus Judaeum (Migne PL 213, cols 749-808): Anonymous medieval anti-Jewish treatise (12th century, edited by Wolfgang Bunte as dating to c. 1122). No English translation found; only Latin text available at Documenta Catholica Omnia.

Vita Mathildis (Migne PL 148, cols 939-1036): Donizo's biography of Matilda of Tuscany (written 1111-1115). Multiple draft English translations of individual sections/chapters exist on Academia.edu (scholarly translations by various scholars), but no complete published English translation of the full work has been located.

Formulae Bignonianae (Migne PL 87, 701-774): Medieval Salic law formulae collection. Part of Karl Zeumer's Formulae Merovingici et Karolini Aevi (MGH Leges V, 1886). No complete English translation found; only scattered formulae cited in scholarly works like Alice Rio's Cambridge studies.

Formulae Novae (Migne PL 87): Medieval legal formulae collection. No English translation found in standard sources. Only mentioned in passing in medieval legal history works; appears not to have been translated into English.

Formulae Sirmondicae (also Formulae Turonenses, Migne PL 87, 750-900): Medieval Frankish legal formulae. No complete English translation found. Alice Rio's Cambridge work and PPTS translations cover some formulae, but not this specific collection as a whole.
